title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 (Build 31) — Premium Luxury Member Portal & Admin Universal QR Redesign
releaseNotes: Premium Luxury Portal UI/UX: Redesigned with deep obsidian base, metallic gold branding, glassmorphism, and restrained multi-colour module accents without bright card borders
3D Animated Visuals: Integrated floating 3D geometric crystal emblem with smooth CSS continuous rotation and lighting
Admin Dashboard Universal QR: Dedicated Universal QR module directly on the main Admin Dashboard with live status and instant action controls
Mobile-First Architecture: 6 core service modules (New Registration, Payments, Feedback, Complaint Desk, Membership, Help & Support)
UPI Payments Gateway: Integrated Prashant Mani Tripathi UPI (prashantmanitripathi2003-2@oksbi) with official QR code, one-click copy, and screenshot verification
Dynamic Seat Matrix: Real-time availability by shift, gold selection highlight, and automatic seat reservation
Strict Privacy Standards: Student account verification and confidential member record retrieval
Removed Clutter: Completely eliminated developer terminology and generic capabilities cards for a finished commercial product experience
